entities.name: Negotiated LLC SAPI
entities.description: Information element indicating the negotiated LLC SAPI value, included when modified during mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode.

entities.name: UE supports A/Gb mode
entities.description: Condition that the UE must support A/Gb mode operation.

entities.name: Negotiated LLC SAPI modified
entities.description: Condition that the negotiated LLC SAPI value has been modified.

entities.name: Network includes Negotiated LLC SAPI IE
entities.description: Network behavior to include the Negotiated LLC SAPI IE when conditions are met.

relations.description: The network includes the Negotiated LLC SAPI IE when specified conditions are satisfied.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that the UE supports A/Gb mode.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that the negotiated LLC SAPI has been modified.
